en.deleteHint: Delete moves the skill into a .trash folder under the same root; restore it from the panel's trash.
en.deleteTrashHint: Delete removes this entry permanently; it cannot be undone.
en.emptyTrashHint: Emptying deletes every trash entry permanently.
en.exportHint: Export the bundle as a .zip (SKILL.md plus its resource files)
en.formRootHint: Write-to picks the root: a project root only applies to this repository and outranks the rest; user Agents (~/.agents/skills) applies to every project and is reusable by other tools that scan it; user DSH (~/.dsh/skills) belongs to DeepSeek Harness alone and outranks a same-named Agents skill.
en.importHint: Pick a .zip skill bundle or a single .md skill file
en.incomplete: The catalog read was incomplete (some providers were unavailable)
en.internalOnly: This skill is embedded in a plugin: it can be viewed but not edited or deleted.
en.modelHint: When off, the skill leaves the model catalog and the skill tool refuses to load it.
en.saveHint: Write the changes back into the SKILL.md frontmatter
en.scopeAutoHint: Follow the session shown in the main area
en.scopeCwd: No session bound; read from the working directory
en.scopeHint: Switch the session scope being browsed: skills resolve from that session's cwd and preset
en.scopePending: Save the pending invocation changes before switching scope
en.subtitle: Manage the skills visible to this session
en.title: Skill Center
en.trashHint: Restore moves the skill back into its original root; Delete removes this entry for good.
en.userHint: When off, the skill disappears from the / menu.
